subject: general
question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given group of words.**

One who rides horses in races
solution:
The correct answer is 'jockey.'

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us explore the marked option: 
 
 
• 'Jockey' is **a person who rides horses in races, especially as a profession**. (घुड़दौड़ में भाग लेने वाला घुड़सवार)

 
 
• For example - *A​ jockey must be brave to ride a horse at high speed*.

 
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us explore the other options:
 
 
• 'Porter' means **a person whose job is to carry suitcases, etc. at a railway station, airport, etc**. (रेलवे स्‍टेशन आदि पर सामान ले जाने वाला व्‍यक्ति; क़ुली)

 
 
• For example - *The **porter** was weighed down by all the luggage*.
 
 
 
• 'Sprinter' means **an athlete who races over a short distance**. (एक एथलीट जो कम दूरी पर दौड़ता है)
 
 
• For example - *Any half-decent **sprinter** can run 100m in 11 seconds*.
 
 
 
• 'Flamboyant' is **a person acting in a loud, confident way that attracts attention**. (भड़कीला व आत्‍मविश्‍वासी और इस कारण ध्यानाकर्षक)
 
 
• For example - *The **flamboyant** singer loves to wear shimmering suits*.
